prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: attached nft-1.png. Create ONE square 2x2 animation sprite sheet: four edge-to-edge equal square tiles, NO gutters, NO text. Each tile repeats the EXACT attached face with identical scale, position, palette, grain, lighting, eyes, nose and backdrop. No head movement. Change ONLY the mouth and immediately adjacent cheeks/chin. TOP LEFT: clearly open talking mouth, substantially bigger than original closed mouth. TOP RIGHT: wide open laughing mouth. BOTTOM LEFT: round open singing mouth. BOTTOM RIGHT: a very large vertically open screaming mouth. Preserve the source's crude blurred sculptural render, colored shadows and surreal expressionless eyes. Mouth interior is softly shaded in the existing dark palette, no photoreal teeth. Keep all facial landmarks aligned to the reference within each square. Four full square copies of the source composition; don't crop or recenter. Output a 2048x2048 sprite sheet.
